container_contract.trusted_components: local daemon, reviewed image and host kernel; not a VM or independent attestation
container_contract.host_crash_recovery: stopped container/private temp files may remain; frozen SHA label identifies attempt; unknown reply never authorizes replay

handoffs: native campaign, routing and source-policy; both trees, inverse rollback, frozen intent, current rights and lost-reply no replay
